composition_variation: Create a sophisticated cel-shaded portrait of Sasuke Uchiha quietly seated on a broad low rooftop parapet at twilight. Preserve his distinctive black spiked hair, dark eyes, pale complexion, and reserved expression. Dress him in a simple dark indigo high-collar casual shirt and charcoal trousers, with empty hands resting naturally on his knees. Keep the pose stable and nonconfrontational. Use layered violet village rooftops, muted apricot horizon light, subtle wind in his hair, and a spacious fading blue sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
